visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair and a beige headband is sitting in a room with neutral curtains. She smiles warmly while looking at her smartphone, eventually holding up a small acrylic standee that mirrors a photo on her screen. (2) A young boy in a grey hoodie holds a small acrylic standee of himself while making a peace sign and smiling at the camera in a brightly lit indoor space. (3) Multiple packaged acrylic items including keychains and standees are spread across a white tabletop. Hands enter the frame to point at various custom products featuring people and pets. (4) A large light-colored Labrador retriever lies calmly on the floor with several small acrylic standees placed in front of it. The camera then cuts to the woman holding up two different acrylic photo cards. (5) A screen recording sequence demonstrates a mobile website interface where a photo of the boy is uploaded, the background is removed automatically, and an acrylic standee layout is generated. (6) Macro close-up shots showcase the physical quality of the acrylic, highlighting the transparency and smooth edges of a standee featuring a young girl in a yellow dress. (7) The woman is back in the room, now standing in front of shelves filled with various toys and collectibles. She points toward the camera and several acrylic products arranged on a table before her, gesturing with high energy and smiles.
